data.narrative:
Pixxel is a Series B frontier-tech company in Space & Aerospace that has raised $95M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private firms including Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse at similar or adjacent stages.

Two methods yielded quantifiable results. Stage-progression analysis, using the $95M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $180M. Peer-median anchoring across 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a $1.5B median valuation. The peer range spans $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space), reflecting material dispersion. Public-comp P/S anchoring was inapplicable due to absence of disclosed revenue data, though the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 26.4x sales across six tickers.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $153M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $840M. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression methods anchor to capital raised rather than operating metrics, while peer multiples are highly sensitive to growth trajectory and market timing within an early-stage, capital-intensive sector. Further diligence on revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would be required to narrow this band.
